sources.title: BGE-Reranker-v2 — BGE documentation
sources.snippet: For efficiency, utilize BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 and the low layer of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise. For better performance, recommand BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-minicpm-layerwise and BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-gemma. Make sure always test on your real use case and choose the one with best speed-quality balance!

sources.title: bge-reranker-v2-m3: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview bge-reranker-v2-m3 is a multilingual reranking model maintained by BAAI that takes a query-passage pair as input and outputs a direct relevance score instead of embeddings. Built on the bge-m3 base model, this model accepts tokenized text pairs with a maximum length of 512 tokens and produces logits that can be converted to normalized scores between 0 and 1 using a sigmoid function ...
